blocks.content: To check if a given string is an anagram, check if both strings have same set of characters.
Let's see a detailed overview of how to solve this problem.

items: First convert the given two strings to char arrays using the toCharArray() method
Sort the char arrays using the Arrays.sort() method.
Check if the sorted char arrays are equal using the Arrays.equals() method.

blocks.content: If the two character arrays are equal, it means the two strings are anagrams, else they are not.
